owner_creation.analysis: The quote_all private c_int owns the Boolean quoting option, initially zero and set to one by parsing -a in main_0.
owner_creation.invariant: The quote-all option is an inline scalar.
limitations: quote_all owns one policy integer and no quoted argument bytes.

aliases_escapes.analysis: The output loop reads the quote_all scalar by value; no pointer to it is passed to printf, the argument Vec or a native object.
aliases_escapes.invariant: Quote selection does not lend mutable storage.
limitations: The quoting flag cannot extend the lifetime of argv or metachars storage.

callback_targets.analysis: The branch selects a literal printf format and direct calls; quote_all does not contain a callback pointer.
callback_targets.invariant: Quote-all is control data, never callable state.
limitations: is_metachar reads policy synchronously; no callable is stored in quote_all.

invalidation.analysis: The quote_all flag has static lifetime and no backing allocation; option parsing finishes before the argument output loop reads it.
invalidation.invariant: Parsing precedes all quote-all output decisions.

mutation_commit.analysis: Parsing -a stores the complete quote_all integer before the output loop; it does not publish any pointer/length pair.
mutation_commit.invariant: Setting -a is a single complete scalar update.

release_pair.analysis: Process image lifetime owns the quote_all flag; ordinary exit requires no free or descriptor close for it.
release_pair.invariant: Quote-all storage has no external release pair.
limitations: Ending quote_all storage does not release any argument or escape buffer.

error_cleanup.analysis: An invalid option calls pr_error and exits; this quote_all scalar needs no rollback or resource cleanup.
error_cleanup.invariant: Parse failure cannot leak a quote-all allocation.

signals_handoff.analysis: The helper runs one startup-thread main_0 invocation; no registered handler mutates quote_all during parsing or output.
limitations: Private single-invocation helper state only; metachars heap ownership and lstrtol arithmetic remain separate pending entries.
